record.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:92 — Committing guests before calendar synchronization makes a later failure unrecoverable by retry because the uniqueness check rejects the persisted guests before calendars or invitations can be repaired.

adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a real issue in addGuests.handler.ts. Looking at the code flow: Line 92-107 commits guests to the database via prisma.booking.update(), then line 163 calls eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(), and line 166 calls sendAddGuestsEmails(). If calendar sync or email sending fails, the guests are already persisted. On retry, the uniqueGuests filter at line 72-76 will filter out already-added guests (since they're now in booking.attendees), causing the uniqueGuests.length === 0 check at line 78 to throw 'emails_must_be_unique_valid' error. This prevents recovery - the user cannot retry to complete calendar sync/emails because the guests are already in the database.
